Teams' Champion: [[Carlin Motorsport|Carlin]] }} The '''2015 MSA Formula Championship''' was a multi-event, [[Formula 4]] [[Open-wheel car|open-wheel single seater]] [[Motorsport|motor racing]] championship held across [[England]] and [[Scotland]]. The championship featured a mix of professional motor racing teams and privately funded drivers, competing in Formula 4 cars that conformed to the technical regulations for the championship. This, the inaugural season, following on from the [[British Formula Ford Championship]], was the first year that the cars conformed to the FIA's Formula 4 regulations.{{cite web|url=http://www.britishformulaford.co.uk/formula-ford-ecoboost-adopts-fia-formula-4-regulations-for-2015/|title=FORMULA FORD ECOBOOST ADOPTS FIA FORMULA 4 REGULATIONS FOR 2015|publisher=British [[Formula Ford]]|date=23 June 2014|access-date=8 September 2014|archive-url=https://archive.today/20140908194917/http://www.britishformulaford.co.uk/formula-ford-ecoboost-adopts-fia-formula-4-regulations-for-2015/|archive-date=2014-09-08|url-status=dead}} Part of the [[TOCA]] tour, it formed part of the extensive program of support categories built up around the [[British Touring Car Championship]] centrepiece.{{cite news|url=http://www.btcc.net/html/generalnews_detail.php?id=3211 |title=Formula Ford returns in 2013 |work=[[British Touring Car Championship]] |publisher=[[TOCA]] |date=12 October 2012 |access-date=12 October 2012 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130723101130/http://www.btcc.net/html/generalnews_detail.php?id=3211 |archive-date=23 July 2013 }} The season commenced on 5 April at [[Brands Hatch]] – on the circuit's Indy configuration – and concluded on 11 October at the same venue, utilising the Grand Prix circuit, after thirty races held at ten meetings, all in support of the [[2015 British Touring Car Championship]]. [[Lando Norris]] won the championship with eight victories, 42 points ahead of [[Ricky Collard]], who won six races. Third-placed [[Colton Herta]] came out victorious four times, [[Sennan Fielding]] and second-highest placed rookie [[Dan Ticktum]] won three races each, [[Matheus Leist]] and [[Sandy Mitchell (racing driver)|Sandy Mitchell]] won twice respectively, and Josh Smith and top rookie [[Enaam Ahmed]] both triumphed just once. ==Championship changes== The championship adopted the technical regulations for the new FIA [[Formula 4]] specification, becoming the official F4 championship in the United Kingdom. The championship kept the [[Ford EcoBoost engine]] but with a power reduction from 200 bhp to 160 bhp, as per the F4 regulations.{{cite news|first=Kevin|last=Turner|title=British Formula Ford teams welcome Formula 4 news|url=http://www.autosport.com/news/report.php/id/114644|work=Autosport.com|publisher=[[Haymarket Media Group|Haymarket Publications]]|date=26 June 2014|access-date=8 September 2014}} The new regulations moved to a new [[carbon fibre]] [[monocoque]] chassis which met FIA F3 safety standards. ==Teams and drivers== All teams were British-registered. {| | {|class="wikitable" style="font-size: 85%;" !
